request: Build a classic arcade game called Void Raider in Java as a CLI/terminal game. Design (from research on classic arcade games): the player pilots a ship that moves left and right near the bottom; waves of enemy raider ships descend from the top in escalating formations (each wave more enemies, faster, more HP); the player fires projectiles upward to destroy enemies (100 points each); enemy contact costs a life, 3 lives total, game over at 0 lives; score shown in the terminal; wave number increases each wave. Java only, no external libraries.

intent.goal: classic arcade game called Void Raider in Java as a CLI/terminal game

planFiles.summary: The main game loop that handles player input, game logic, and rendering. Manages the game state, including player ship, enemies, projectiles, and the game world.
The Player class that represents the player's ship. Has properties for position, health, and movement speed. Implements movement and shooting behaviors.
The Enemy class that represents the enemy ships. Has properties for position, health, speed, and attack power. Implements enemy movement and attack patterns.
The Projectile class that represents the player's shots. Has properties for position, speed, and damage. Implements the shooting logic and collision detection with enemies.

The Render class that handles the terminal output. Implements the ASCII art rendering of the game world, player ship, enemies, and projectiles. Manages the game's ASCII art and updates it every frame.
